videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: Links to single videos: YouTube (videos, Shorts), TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook videos and Reels, X (Twitter), Vimeo and 1,000+ other sites. Profile, playlist and search pages are not supported.

translateTo.title: Translate to
translateTo.description: Optional: also translate the transcript and subtitles into this language. Leave empty for the original language only.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language (en, uk, es, de, ...). Leave empty to detect it automatically.

useCaptions.title: Use the video's captions when available
useCaptions.description: On: uploaded or automatic captions are used when the video has them (fast, any length, one flat price). Off: the speech is always recognised with Whisper (better punctuation, charged per minute).

maxDurationMinutes.title: Maximum video length for speech recognition (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.description: Videos without captions that are longer than this are skipped (not charged). Captions are used for any length.

quality.title: Speech recognition model
quality.description: accurate = Whisper large-v3 (best for non-English languages); fast = Whisper large-v3-turbo. Same price.

subtitles.title: SRT and VTT subtitle files
subtitles.description: Also save SRT and VTT files (original and translation) with download links (free).

includeSegments.title: Timestamped segments
includeSegments.description: Include the timestamped segments (start, end, text) in the output, not only the full text.
